stories.summary: US stock futures for the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq were little changed as crude oil prices approached the $100-a-barrel level. The steadiness comes even as rising oil costs raise concerns about inflation heading into the trading day.

stories.whyItMatters: A sustained oil-driven selloff could spread beyond energy-sensitive sectors and test how much bad news the market can absorb.
